recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, high-contrast close-up portrait of a man with an intense gaze, rendered in a warm amber and black duotone palette, featuring bold vertical typography aligned to the left edge.
coreVisualRelationships: The vertical text acts as a structural pillar against the organic curves of the face.
The high-contrast lighting creates a deep black negative space on the left that cradles the typography.
The amber-to-red gradient in the highlights emphasizes the intensity of the subject's expression.
coreInvariants: Amber/Orange monochromatic color cast on the subject
Deep black background on the left third
Extreme close-up cropping of the face

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject's face occupies the right two-thirds of the frame at an extreme scale, cropped at the forehead and chin.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, specifically the one centered in the frame, serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the large vertical text on the left, across the bridge of the nose to the subject's eyes, then down to the clenched fist.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid black vertical band on the left side provides a high-contrast foundation for the title.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black for shadows and background negative space.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant amber/yellow for primary highlights and skin tones.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Subtle red-orange mid-tones and thin red secondary text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the warm tones with extreme value contrast between the highlights and the black background.

composition.relationshipToImage: separates display text from the subject

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Size and color contrast within the same typeface family or similar geometric sans-serifs.

avoid: Horizontal orientation for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and condensed nature of the display text.
Provides the necessary verticality and industrial feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, extreme close-up portrait of a man with an intense expression, lit with a strong amber/orange duotone effect. The left third of the image should be solid black negative space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold, condensed sans-serif title in white, rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise, aligned to the left edge. Add a smaller subtitle in red, also rotated 90 degrees, placed between the title and the subject.

verificationChecks: Is the text rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise?
Is the color palette strictly warm (amber/red/black)?
Is the left side of the image a solid black void for the text?

adjustableVariables: Width of the black negative space
Font weight of the display text
mustRedesign: Do not use horizontal text for the main title
Do not include any cool colors like blue or green
Do not use a full-body shot; maintain the extreme close-up
postGenerationChecks: Check that the white text is perfectly legible against the black background.
Ensure the subject's eyes are in sharp focus.
Verify the vertical alignment of all text elements.
Confirm the duotone effect covers the entire subject.
recipe.reuseFormula: Extreme close-up portrait + Amber/Black duotone + Left-aligned vertical bold sans-serif typography.
